why: Settled with the number-like reading (Readings): a key is written as a value is, and 10.0foo is the path 10, 0foo (L496-498). 1e+5.5 is the JSON number 1e+5 then .5, so the path 1e+5, 5. typesafe/config and pyhocon reject the + — the same lenient/forbidden-+ biproduct as path-expressions/024, not a different rule.
